name: Bitcoin
description: Bitcoin is the first decentralized cryptocurrency, a peer-to-peer electronic cash system secured by proof-of-work mining with a fixed supply of 21 million coins.

name: Ethereum
description: Ethereum is a programmable blockchain that runs smart contracts and decentralized applications. It moved to proof-of-stake in 2022 with The Merge.

name: Tether
description: Tether is the largest US dollar stablecoin, issued on many chains and backed by reserves held by Tether Limited.

name: BNB
description: BNB powers the BNB Chain ecosystem and offers fee discounts on the Binance exchange. Supply is reduced through quarterly burns.

name: Solana
description: Solana is a high-throughput Layer 1 blockchain combining proof-of-history with proof-of-stake to offer fast, low-cost transactions.

name: USDC
description: USDC is a fully reserved US dollar stablecoin issued by Circle, redeemable 1:1 for dollars.

name: XRP
description: XRP is the native asset of the XRP Ledger, designed for fast and inexpensive cross-border payments.

name: Toncoin
description: TON is a Layer 1 blockchain originally designed by Telegram, now developed by an open community and integrated into the Telegram app.

name: Dogecoin
description: Dogecoin started as a joke in 2013 based on the Shiba Inu meme and became one of the most widely held cryptocurrencies.

name: Cardano
description: Cardano is a research-driven proof-of-stake blockchain built on peer-reviewed protocols, featuring the Ouroboros consensus.

name: TRON
description: TRON is a high-throughput blockchain widely used for stablecoin transfers, especially USDT.

name: Avalanche
description: Avalanche is a smart contract platform with subnets that let projects launch custom, interoperable blockchains.

name: Shiba Inu
description: Shiba Inu is a community-driven meme token with its own Layer 2, Shibarium, and a DEX called ShibaSwap.

name: Chainlink
description: Chainlink is a decentralized oracle network that brings real-world data such as prices on-chain for smart contracts.

name: Polkadot
description: Polkadot connects specialised blockchains called parachains under a shared security model run by its relay chain.

name: Bitcoin Cash
description: Bitcoin Cash is a 2017 fork of Bitcoin with larger blocks aimed at cheaper on-chain payments.

name: NEAR Protocol
description: NEAR is a sharded proof-of-stake blockchain focused on usability, with human-readable accounts and chain abstraction.

name: Litecoin
description: Litecoin is one of the earliest Bitcoin forks, using Scrypt mining and 2.5-minute blocks for faster payments.

name: Dai
description: Dai is a decentralized, crypto-collateralised stablecoin soft-pegged to the US dollar and governed by MakerDAO.

name: Internet Computer
description: The Internet Computer runs smart contracts called canisters that can serve web content directly at web speed.

name: Uniswap
description: UNI is the governance token of Uniswap, the largest decentralized exchange using automated market makers.

name: Aptos
description: Aptos is a Layer 1 using the Move language and parallel execution, built by former Meta Diem engineers.

name: Kaspa
description: Kaspa is a proof-of-work blockchain built on the GHOSTDAG protocol, allowing parallel blocks and very fast confirmations.

name: Stellar
description: Stellar is an open payments network for issuing and exchanging digital representations of money.

name: UNUS SED LEO
description: LEO is the utility token of the iFinex ecosystem, including the Bitfinex exchange, with regular buybacks and burns.

name: OKB
description: OKB is the utility token of the OKX exchange and the gas token of its X Layer network.

name: Cronos
description: Cronos is the native token of the Cronos chain and the Crypto.com ecosystem.

name: KuCoin Token
description: KCS is the native token of the KuCoin exchange, giving holders fee discounts and a share of trading fees.

name: First Digital USD
description: FDUSD is a US dollar stablecoin issued by First Digital Trust in Hong Kong, popular on centralized exchanges.

name: Sui
description: Sui is an object-centric Layer 1 built in Move, designed for parallel execution and low-latency finality.

name: Hedera
description: Hedera is a public ledger using hashgraph consensus, governed by a council of global enterprises.

name: Polygon
description: Polygon is a suite of Ethereum scaling solutions, including Polygon PoS and zkEVM, secured by the POL token.

name: Arbitrum
description: Arbitrum is the largest Ethereum optimistic rollup by value locked, offering cheaper and faster transactions.

name: Optimism
description: Optimism is an Ethereum Layer 2 rollup and the foundation of the Superchain, a network of OP Stack chains.

name: Immutable
description: Immutable is a Layer 2 platform for web3 gaming, offering zero-gas NFT minting and trading.

name: Mantle
description: Mantle is a modular Ethereum Layer 2 with a large treasury, using EigenDA for data availability.

name: Stacks
description: Stacks brings smart contracts and DeFi to Bitcoin, settling its transactions on the Bitcoin blockchain.

name: Starknet
description: Starknet is a validity rollup on Ethereum using STARK proofs and the Cairo programming language.

name: Loopring
description: Loopring is a zkRollup protocol for scalable, low-cost trading and payments on Ethereum.

name: Aave
description: Aave is a decentralized lending protocol where users supply assets to earn interest or borrow against collateral.

name: Maker
description: MKR is the governance token of MakerDAO, the protocol behind the Dai stablecoin.

name: Lido DAO
description: Lido is the largest liquid staking protocol, issuing stETH in exchange for staked ETH.

name: The Graph
description: The Graph is an indexing protocol for querying blockchain data through open APIs called subgraphs.

name: PancakeSwap
description: PancakeSwap is the leading decentralized exchange on BNB Chain, with CAKE used for farming and governance.

name: Curve DAO
description: Curve is a DEX optimised for swapping similarly priced assets like stablecoins, governed by CRV holders.

name: Synthetix
description: Synthetix is a derivatives liquidity protocol powering perpetual futures across several chains.

name: Compound
description: Compound is an algorithmic money market protocol on Ethereum; COMP holders govern its parameters.

name: Pepe
description: PEPE is a meme coin inspired by the Pepe the Frog internet meme, launched on Ethereum in 2023.

name: dogwifhat
description: dogwifhat is a Solana meme coin featuring a Shiba Inu wearing a knitted hat.

name: Bonk
description: Bonk is a community meme coin on Solana, airdropped to the Solana community in late 2022.

name: FLOKI
description: FLOKI is a meme coin named after Elon Musk's dog, with a web3 game and DeFi utilities.

name: Algorand
description: Algorand is a pure proof-of-stake blockchain with instant finality, founded by Turing Award winner Silvio Micali.

name: Cosmos Hub
description: Cosmos is an ecosystem of interoperable blockchains connected by the IBC protocol; ATOM secures the Cosmos Hub.
